caption:
Between two sentences, a comma before "however" is a trap.

"However" can't join two sentences with just a comma. Use "; however,": The trail looked easy; however, it took hours.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Between two sentences, a comma before "however" is a trap. It's "; however,".

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: The Semicolon Before "However"
youtube.description: Between two complete sentences, "however" needs a semicolon before it and a comma after it. A comma alone makes a comma splice.
